title: Depaint
summary: DEPAINT, verb transitive [Latin To paint.] 1. To paint; to picture; to represent in colors, as by painting the resemblance. 2. To describe in words.

inlines.v: DEPAINT, verb transitive [Latin To paint.] 1. To paint; to picture; to represent in colors, as by painting the resemblance. 2. To describe in words.
